name: AppWorld
summary: Benchmark and sandbox of 9 simulated day-to-day apps operable via 457 APIs and populated by ~100 simulated people, for evaluating function-calling and interactive coding agents.
description: Agents complete natural tasks by writing code that calls the apps' APIs on behalf of a supervisor; Evaluation uses database-state-based unit tests that also catch collateral damage. Includes a task explorer, API explorer, leaderboard and an AppWorld MCP server/client for evaluating terminal agents such as Codex and Gemini CLI. ACL 2024 Best Resource Paper (arXiv 2407.18901). Installs from PyPI as `appworld`.
